summary: While {person} and allies are out of the chamber, the members who stayed choose the committee chairs.
realLife: Chicago aldermen opposed to Harold Washington filled the chairmanships after the mayor and his allies walked out in 1983.
inGame: needs: attendance at the chair election.

turns.what: The chair election waits for the members who left.
turns.writesBack: The clerk adjourns the election without appointments.

turns.what: One committee gets a chair before the walkout.
turns.writesBack: The minutes distinguish filled and vacant chairs.
